insight: From the team behind Gatsby — its core is Apache-2.0, but the enterprise modules in ee/ ship source-available under a separate license.
name: Mastra
tagline: TypeScript framework for building AI agents and workflows.
description: An open-source TypeScript stack for AI applications: agents, a graph-based workflow engine (.then/.branch/.parallel), memory, tools, and built-in observability behind one API. Run it self-hosted under Apache 2.0, or deploy to Mastra Cloud with a free Starter tier and paid Teams/Enterprise plans.

modelSupport.notes: Switch providers through a single model API.
